Data Scientist Dozee, Bangalore

June, 2022- August,2023

The work involves building AI-driven statistical and parametric models to derive meaningful features and information from the complex signal (ballistocardiography and electrocardiography signals). Following were the major projects I was involved in:

S K I L L S

Languages & Frameworks: Python, SQL, PySpark, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Github

Developed and tested an efficient algorithm to calculate the Respiratory Rate vitals from the Ballistocardiography signals. Testing of data was done on 8000 hrs. of data in uncontrolled settings and 584 hours of data in controlled settings.

AI/ML Expertise: Generative AI, LLM (Transformer Models), Predictive Modelling, Causal Modelling, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, A/B Testing, Time Series Analysis

Analyzing sleep patterns from ballistocardiography(BCG) data for automated sleep staging.

Created a pipeline for the analysis of over 14000 Heart Rate (HR) and Respiratory Rate (RR) vital points for getting US-FDA 510K clearance.

Cloud, APIs & Developer Tools: Azure Databricks, GCP, BigQuery, FastAPI, Postman

Creating a model for signal quality classification from the ECG data that will be helpful for Arrhythmia Detection pipeline.

NLP & GenAI: LangChain, Prompt Engineering, Hugging Face, LangGraph, Vectorstore (FAISS, Pinecone)

Apnea/Non-Apnea classification from the BCG signal using the methods of deep learning.

Mentor, Talentsprint & IIT-Madras (Part-Time)

Jul 2023 - Apr 2024

Advanced Data Science and Machine Learning (ADSML) Program

Mentored participants in the year-long ADSML program by reviewing programming assignments, resolving doubts, and providing guidance on key machine learning concepts.

Assisted professionals in capstone projects, offering technical insights and feedback to ensure successful project completion.

Evaluated participant performance, providing constructive feedback to enhance their understanding and practical application of AI/ML techniques.

M A J O R P R O J E C T S

YouTube Blog Generator with Human Feedback using Agentic AI

Freelance [repository]

Feb, 2025

Developed an automated workflow using LangGraph that extracts YouTube transcripts, summarizes video content with an LLM, and generates engaging blog posts. Integrated a human-in-the-loop feedback mechanism for iterative content refinement, ensuring high-quality outputs. Designed a Streamlit-based interface to facilitate real-time user review and approval of generated blogs and deployed the model via streamlit.

High-Speed HDR Video Reconstruction using Hybrid Intensity Frames and Events

IIT-Madras, India [slides]

July, 2021 - April, 2022

This project aims to prove the efficiency of event-based interpolation as compared to other non-event based techniques for efficient HDR video reconstruction. We simulated the event data and used the techniques of deep learning for event-based interpolation and HDR reconstruction.

Curriculum learning in Neural Networks, IIT Madras, India [report]

Jan, 2020 - March, 2020

We demonstrated the concept of curriculum learning on neural networks, where we trained a network initially on the

custom-made lines dataset and used their initial layer weights as the initialization for the training on characters dataset.

We could clearly observe that learning from scratch was much slower as compared to learning from these pre-trained weights.

Ventilator Assignment Problem Freelance [report] December, 2020

Given patient level data with their characteristics and another data containing time series biometric information of the

patients, we aim to reduce patient mortality by identifying high risk patients based on the available data and devoting the limited ventilators to them. Firstly, I combined the two data and had done necessary feature engineering, exploratory data analysis and based on feature importance, I had added extra features to give it as an input to various tree-based classifiers. It was found that the gradient boosting technique(Catboost) was found to give better results among all the classifiers.
